record.chaining: The platform's general free cloud promotion covers apps and databases, not a free model-inference allowance.

limits.value: member plans from BRL 20 a month with use renewed every 5 hours and weekly; per-1M-token credit pricing otherwise

identity_cost.detail: a Zenifra account and an organization API key funded by PIX or boleto; no free inference credit stated

record.reliability_note: the API key pauses at its budget limit until the window renews, with no extra charge

evidence.proved: Zenifra AI charges per million tokens from organization credit or via fixed member plans, with no free inference tier
evidence.quote: Na IA por demanda, a organização paga por milhão de tokens com o crédito, sem mensalidade.
